public class PrizeCard {
    private String owner;
    private int tickets;
    private boolean active;

    public PrizeCard(String ownerName, int startingTickets, boolean startingActive) {
        owner = ownerName;
        tickets = startingTickets;
        active = startingActive;
    }
    public String getOwner() { return owner; }
    public int getTickets() { return tickets; }
    public boolean isActive() { return active; }
    public void setOwner(String newOwner) { owner = newOwner; }
    public void setActive(boolean newStatus) { active = newStatus; }
    public void addTickets(int amount) {
        if (amount > 0) { this.tickets += amount; }
    }
    public boolean canRedeem(int cost) {
        return active && cost > 0 && tickets >= cost;
    }
    public boolean redeemTickets(int cost) {
        if (canRedeem(cost)) {
            tickets -= cost;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
}
